# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-01T23:50Z · next run ~05:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-02T13:50Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com
World State 42/100 (Strained) · 18 Alert · 37 Watch · 34 Normal Headline: Iran talks in Doha run a third day as Hormuz stays largely shut. Russia launched 759 drones at Ukraine on 1 Nov, Cyclone Murasu nears India's east coast, and the FBI blamed North Korea for a record $6.3bn Binance theft.
## Situations (9 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, worsening]: Hormuz largely closed after tanker attacks on 30–31 Oct; Brent above $110, TTF above €100; Doha talks in a third day on 1 Nov. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: 759 Russian drones launched on 1 Nov in two waves, cutting power to hundreds of thousands; drones disrupted Jersey airport on 30–31 Oct. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, hybrid-threats, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.2: drought in Australia and East Africa, record warmth and weaker carbon sinks. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: 10,351 cases and 5,026 deaths reported on 1 Nov, with cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Record drone attacks on civilians in October; the army rejects talks; famine confirmed in 2025. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - Cyclone Murasu [ALERT, worsening]: GDACS red alert; IMD expects landfall on south Andhra Pradesh late on 2 Nov with gusts to 120km/h; Odisha evacuating. → alert: other-cyclones; normal: floods - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread near 160bp; mass social protests for a third weekend, spreading to Germany. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI at 4.0% on the oil shock; a Bank of England rise to 4% widely expected on 5 Nov; Egypt hiked on 29 Oct. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility; normal: em-stress - Record Binance hack attributed to North Korea [WATCH, worsening]: About $6.3bn drained from Binance in late October; FBI blamed North Korea on 1 Nov; withdrawals reopening, reserves proof due 3 Nov. → watch: crypto, cyber, korea
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] worsening: FAO food index at 136, up 5.8% on a year - Sahel insurgency [sahel] stable: JNIM fuel blockade on Bamako persists; insurgency pressing toward Guinea - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK terrorism threat level raised to Severe: an attack is highly likely
